requirements.description: The user prefers properties near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The building must have energy class D or better, so classes A1 through D are accepted. Location (Turin, proximity to green spaces) and the school-to-nursery conversion are outside the energy scope and were not used as filters.
